name: rowFixingLevel_le_levelOf
summary: The lower block of w·A = w (w = [s; ϖ̄·1]) is ϖ̄·Ā = ϖ̄·1, which by genResidue_smul_eq_iff means Ā ≡ 1 at every chosen place.

steps.claim: Let k be in the level, with reduction A modulo M²Q in rowStabilizer reduceToR₀ w e (a: w·Ā = w; b: the columns off V.fixedEmb are those of 1). The lower rows of w·Ā = w give ϖ̄·Ā = ϖ̄·1 = ϖ̄·I_id, so by genResidue_smul_eq_iff (with u = id) the reduction of A at each chosen place is 1; this reduction is that of k (reductionK₀_map_modulusResidue), so k ∈ levelOf O.chosenPlace ⊥.
steps.lean:
levelOf O.chosenPlace ⊥ := fun _ ⟨k, a, b⟩ ↦ ⟨k, funext fun l ↦
  Units.ext ((reductionK₀_map_modulusResidue ..).symm.trans ((V.genResidue_smul_eq_iff _ id).1
  (by simpa [DividedSplitting.stackOverGenScalar, inclMatrix] using congrArg toRows₂ a.2) l)), b⟩
